2092511665464152120.text:
Kennan Davison is insane for this

> absolutely hates school
> nobody thinks he'll amount to much
> becomes Top 200 in League of Legends
> one of ~100M players

Age 18
> lives with parents to save money
> starts grinding 100-hour weeks
> transfers into Columbia
> realizes lectures aren't the move
> drops out at 19
> joins Pinterest as the youngest employee

2020
> quits Pinterest
> founds Skio
> cracks YC S20 solo
> fails spectacularly during the batch
> refuses to die, pivots

2021–2024
> Skio starts compounding
> raises $8M seed
> builds team to 50+
> grows profitable with $15M ARR
> then $25M, then ~$32M ARR

2025
> starts Icon: "ChatGPT for ads"
> goes viral, blows past $5M ARR in ~30 days
> raises $9.2M seed led by Founders Fund
> backed by OpenAI, Pika, Ramp, Cognition
> recruits ex-Google, Meta, Pinterest

Then does something insane
> buys http://icon.com for $12 million
> 6th-largest domain sale ever recorded
> rebrands it as "world's first AI CMO"

2026
> realizes AI-generated ads look like trash
> pivots Icon into "The Human Admaker"
> real human UGC creators + AI-assisted
> software instead of pure AI slop
> Icon ads generate 1B+ views combined
> rapid scaling to 75+ employees

> Skio gets acquired by Recharge
> walks away with $105M cash

Bro dropped out of college, got benched from his own YC batch, and still ended up 2-for-2 on exits/pivots that actually printed money.

What's your excuse?

> be Nikola Mrkšić
> spawn in Serbia, year 1991
> get obsessed with maths and computers
> crack University of Cambridge
> go deep into NLP before it was cool
> completes BA + MSc + PhD at Cambridge
> joins VocalIQ as first engineer in 2011
> build real-world dialogue models
> publish research on spoken dialogue and RL
> Apple acquires VocalIQ for $50M+
> move to Apple Siri team as ML researcher
> work on Siri’s next-gen language models
> 2017 - leave Apple to start PolyAI
> rebuild entire voice infra from scratch
> brutal early days, continue to ship
> raise seed from Amadeus
> PolyAI voice agents go live in call centers
> customers start telling customers
> revenue crosses millions
> 2019 - raise Series A
> ChatGPT launches
> inbound leads jump 4x overnight
> 2022 - raise $40M Series B
> Poly becomes a $260M company
> clients: FedEx, Marriott, Whitbread
> millions of calls handled
> 80% of calls without human in 24+ languages
> 2021 - Forbes 30 Under 30 Europe
> 2024 - raise a whopping $50M Series C
> Nvidia joins the mission
> 2025 - everyone starts building voice AI
> Poly still leading the way
> raise another $86M Series D
> 500ms latency in raven v3
> handles interruptions & emotional cues
> 300+ employees around the globe
> currently valued at ~$750 MILLION

From being born at the exact time when his entire country was falling apart to building a deep-tech startup worth more than half a billion dollars.

Nikola Mrkšić for you, ladies and gentlemen.
